## TotemAutomata 0.1.22

- Adds a module-owned Totem Automata Creative Mode tab for the Copper Wrench.
- Makes source and destination lines follow the Copper Golem's interpolated
  client position every render frame while retaining server-authoritative links.
- Keeps eight visible allow and deny rules per pane and adds independent,
  row-based scrolling with visible ranges when either list exceeds that limit.
- Extends native client and Observer regression coverage for the updated UI.
- Requires TotemCore 0.7.14 or newer within the 0.7.x compatibility line.

Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric · Java 25
